title: Poise & Break — Turn Panel
description: A turn panel for Exalted: Essence. On your turn it reads your target's state and offers only the attacks that are legal against them — withering while they still have Poise, decisive once they are in Break — then opens the system's own roller. Built for the Combat Reforged rules from the Storyteller's Guide, and falls back to standard rules when that setting is off.
